title: Correct Ampere Force
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 0.6 N.

title: Correct Friction Force
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 0 N.

title: Correct Resistance Range
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be a range from 3.5 Ω to 21.5 Ω.

title: Circuit Current Calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the circuit current using Ohm's Law (I = E/(R1+R2)).

title: Ampere Force Application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply F = BIL to find the magnetic force on the rod.

title: Force Balance Analysis
description: Important: The student must set up a correct force balance equation along the incline, including gravity, Ampere force, and friction components.

title: Friction Direction Logic
description: Important: For part (2), the student must recognize that the net force along the incline is zero, leading to zero friction.

title: Sign Error in Force Components
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student misassigns the direction of the Ampere force component or friction along the incline.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: The student should correctly convert mass to kg and maintain consistent SI units throughout.
